title: HelperSSHLaneResult
description: The lane's answer, which is a CHANNEL ID and not a second identity: what the helper opened is an ordinary channel — its bytes are keyed by that id, it is ended by `close`, and its end arrives as `ssh.channel-closed`. The one thing a lane adds to that plane is the exit status its far end reports, which is a field of the closed event and not of this result.

channel.description: The channel the lane's bytes are keyed by, minted by the helper — the end that owns the channel — and echoed back verbatim on every frame and on the close.
